title: Protection from Inclement Weather for Workers Transported in Lorries
what_it_is: Protection from Inclement Weather for Workers Transported in Lorries

sections.label: Lorry canopy requirement and offences
sections.summary: Since 2011 lorries ferrying persons in rear decks must have canopies, and offenders face fines, imprisonment, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Since 2011, lorries used to ferry any persons in their rear decks are required to be fitted with canopies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Failure to do so is an offence under the Road Traffic Act.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: First-time offenders will face a fine of up to $1,000, an imprisonment term of up to three months, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For the first half of 2021, we caught 23 offenders with lorries ferrying workers without canopies, or without having a sufficiently large canopy to shelter all workers.

sections.label: Rain covers and severe weather
sections.summary: Employers are encouraged to install rain covers and consider delaying trips during heavy rain, as canopies alone may not suffice.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In the event of severe weather, we recognise that the canopy alone may not confer sufficient protection from the elements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We certainly do encourage employers to take the initiative to install rain covers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: These are typically waterproof canvas tarps that are installed on the sides of the rear deck, to complement canopies which serve primarily as a roof shelter.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Where possible, employers should also consider putting on hold such trips until the heavy rain has passed.
